title: Ztreak: Habit Tracker
subtitle: Build habits at your own pace
description: Track daily, weekly or monthly habits and goals. Follow your streaks, protect an eligible miss and enjoy an optional tower game.
nativeNote: Manual tracking works in your browser. Steps and digital usage require the mobile app and device permissions.

features.title: Choose the frequency
features.text: Set daily goals or quotas for each week, month, or year.

features.title: Shield
features.text: You need an active streak. You have only one shield: two consecutive missed cycles break the streak. A pending record is not a miss.

features.title: Tower · optional
features.text: From completing goals to building with cards.

features.title: Stored data
features.text: Ztreak stores your goals, names, entries, dates, quantities, drafts, preferences and Tower progress on this device. They are used to show your history, calculate streaks and recover changes. Account sign-in is optional. There is no advertising or analytics.
